facts.text: Raffles The Palm Dubai opened in 2021 as the first Raffles beach resort in the Middle East.
facts.excerpt: The first Raffles beach resort in the Middle East, 5-star Raffles The Palm Dubai, opened in 2021.

facts.text: The hotel has ornate Baroque-style architecture.
facts.excerpt: The ornate Baroque-style architecture sets the tone for every element of the hotel

facts.text: The hotel's design includes handcrafted furniture and 6,000 Swarovski crystal chandeliers.
facts.excerpt: from its remarkable collection of handcrafted furniture to its 6,000 Swarovski crystal chandeliers

facts.text: Rooms feature bespoke Francesco Molon furnishings.
facts.excerpt: With bespoke Francesco Molon furnishings, exclusive amenities, and advanced multimedia

facts.text: All rooms have private balconies with views, or are steps from the garden, beach or pool.
facts.excerpt: all of our beautifully appointed rooms have private balconies with sensational views, or are just steps from our garden, pristine beach or pool.

facts.text: Raffles Butlers are available around the clock.
facts.excerpt: Our legendary Raffles Butlers are on hand around the clock

facts.text: The Royal Villa has a private entrance, four bedrooms, a Rosa Portogallo marble bathroom, a rooftop pool and a dedicated spa.
facts.excerpt: Our Royal Villa epitomises refined grandeur with a private entrance, four bedrooms, a Rosa Portogallo marble bathroom, a rooftop pool, a dedicated spa

facts.text: Club-level suites include Raffles Club Lounge access, where Club guests get complimentary breakfast, afternoon tea and aperitifs.
facts.excerpt: Club guests enjoy complimentary breakfast, afternoon tea, aperitifs, and access to the serene lounge environment

facts.text: Piatti by the Beach is a beachfront restaurant serving authentic southern Italian dishes.
facts.excerpt: Discover our atmospheric beachfront restaurant where authentic Italian dishes served in fresh, contemporary surroundings evoke the beguiling charm of southern Italy.

facts.text: Kalian is a rooftop lounge with views of the Dubai skyline and a menu of sharing plates.
facts.excerpt: Kalian, a rooftop lounge offering spectacular views of the Dubai skyline. Savour a delightful menu of sharing plates

facts.text: The Grand Palaces Afternoon Tea is served in the Bluthner Hall.
facts.excerpt: Grand Palaces Afternoon Tea in the breathtaking Blüthner Hall

facts.text: The Cinq Mondes Spa covers 3,000 square meters.
facts.excerpt: Our spacious 3,000 sqm Cinq Mondes Spa is a wellbeing sanctuary

facts.text: The spa has authentic Moroccan and Turkish hammams, tepidariums, steam rooms, saunas and ice fountains.
facts.excerpt: authentic Moroccan and Turkish hammams, tepidariums and steam rooms, relaxation lounges, saunas, experience showers and ice fountains

facts.text: Spa treatments include the Omorovicza facial and Psammo Therapy.
facts.excerpt: Explore a range of treatments, including the Omorovicza facial and Psammo Therapy

facts.text: The spa offers VIP spa suites for couples.
facts.excerpt: Yes, Cinq Mondes Spa offers VIP spa suites ideal for couples

facts.text: Guests can enjoy a private beach and multiple swimming pools.
facts.excerpt: Guests can enjoy a private beach, outdoor activities, multiple swimming pools

facts.text: The hotel has the largest indoor pool on The Palm.
facts.excerpt: and the largest indoor pool on The Palm

facts.text: The hotel has one of the largest indoor pools on the Palm.
facts.excerpt: one of the largest indoor pool on the Palm and a sumptuous hammam

facts.text: The Kids Club runs an edutainment programme exploring art, nature and culture.
facts.excerpt: programme inviting little guests to explore art, nature and culture

facts.text: The hotel is on the West Crescent of Palm Jumeirah in Dubai.
facts.excerpt: West Crescent Palm Jumeirah 212484 Dubai United Arab Emirates

facts.text: The Mall of the Emirates is a short drive away.
facts.excerpt: shopping at the nearby Mall of the Emirates, all just a short drive away

facts.text: The best time to visit is the cooler months from October to April.
facts.excerpt: The best time to visit is during the cooler months, from October to April

facts.text: Spa treatments are available for adults over 18.
facts.excerpt: Spa treatments are available for adults over the age of 18 years

facts.text: Children under 16 are not permitted in the spa thermal areas.
facts.excerpt: Children under the age of 16 years are not permitted in the spa thermal areas

facts.text: The hotel advises that some services and facilities may be momentarily unavailable or operating with reduced availability.
facts.excerpt: some services and facilities may be momentarily unavailable or operating with reduced availability

facts.text: Non-guests can buy a Pool and Beach Day Pass for the beach and outdoor pool.
facts.excerpt: The pass is valid for the beach and outdoor pool between 9.00am and 7.00pm

facts.text: The fitness centre is open 24 hours for in-house guests.
facts.excerpt: Fitness Centre is open 24 hours exclusively for in-house guests

facts.text: The hotel says its rooms, suites and villas are the most spacious on The Palm Jumeirah.
facts.excerpt: Our rooms, suites and private villas are the most spacious on The Palm Jumeirah
